meta.name: mem-setup
meta.description: This skill should be used when the user asks to "set up claude-mem", "pair claude-mem", "connect cmem", "add my cmem key", "set up cloud sync in Cowork", or provides cmem.ai Connect values (sync token, user id, SyncHub URL) for this plugin. Configures the claude-mem-cowork plugin credentials.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 输入 cmem 连接信息,完成 claude-mem 凭证配置
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要为 claude-mem 插件配置连接凭证
copy.tagline_en: Enter cmem connection details and complete the claude-mem credential setup.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to configure claude-mem plugin credentials.

howto.what: 把你在 cmem.ai 拿到的 sync token、user id 和 SyncHub URL 写进插件的 config.json,让 hook 能捕获并注入记忆。若本机装有本地 claude-mem,还可选把同样的值写入它的 settings.json。
howto.when: 当你要求设置或配对 claude-mem、连接 cmem 等,或直接给出 cmem.ai Connect 的三个值时触发。

say.note: 它会向你要 cmem.ai 的三个值

say.text: 这是我的 cmem Connect 信息:……
say.note: 它从中提取三个值写入配置

say.text: 验证一下配对是否生效
say.note: 运行 status 并汇报打码后的输出

howto.what_en: Writes your cmem.ai sync token, user id and SyncHub URL into the plugin's config.json so hooks can capture and inject memory. Optionally saves the same values to a local claude-mem settings.json if present.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to set up or pair claude-mem, connect cmem, and similar requests, or when you paste your cmem.ai Connect values.

say_en.note: It asks for your cmem.ai values
It pulls the three values into config
Runs status and reports masked output
